eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Nine
subtitle: Lesson 82 · Window and Ranking Functions

code:
SELECT Name, ListPrice,
  NTILE(4) OVER (ORDER BY ListPrice DESC)
    AS PriceQuartile
FROM Production.Product;
caption: 4 roughly equal groups — group 1 is the most expensive quarter.

code:
-- 22 rows into NTILE(4):
-- groups get 6, 6, 5, 5 rows
-- Extra rows go to the EARLIEST groups first
caption: No group differs from another by more than one row.

code:
SELECT Name, Color, ListPrice,
  NTILE(4) OVER (
    PARTITION BY Color ORDER BY ListPrice DESC)
    AS QuartileInColor
FROM Production.Product;
caption: Quartiles computed SEPARATELY within each color.
